label: ANALYSIS_OF_MEASURED_RUN
why_not: plain and tools were not run. grade_merged.py REFUSED to grade, correctly: a verdict over a subset of arms is the error merge_phase4.py exists to prevent.

correct_abstention_pct.detail: 10 of 10 abstain cases abstained. v1 alone scored 66.67 on its worst arm.

retrieval_hit_pct.detail: 21 of 22; the single miss is RAG-EN-003, the regression PREDICTED and PRE-RECORDED in the D-0098 manifest before the run.

contaminated_do_not_record.reason: 14 of the 18 CONTRADICTED claims are grader artefacts, MEASURED and reproduced directly against rag.citations.
artefact_classes: 'Form 10-K' -> the form designator 10 read as a financial quantity
contaminated_do_not_record.remaining_4: all R47: the model QUOTES a table row ('Net income | 96,995') where the scale word precedes the number, so no scale is applied. Known, documented, deliberately unfixed.

new_findings.over_abstention_RAG-FA-001: A Persian question the model COULD answer, with correct retrieval, was refused. Over-abstention is not counted by correct_abstention_pct_min, which only scores the abstain cases. A model that refuses everything would score 100 there.
new_findings.fa_not_in_persian: 2 of 7 Persian cases answered in English -- both are abstain cases (RAG2-ABST-003, RAG2-ABST-006) that refused in English. Relevant to R10, not yet graded.

r49_outcome: The combined set delivered what it was built for: correct_abstention now has 10 cases and citation_correctness has 22 answerable -- but the citation number itself is unusable until the extractor is fixed.
